versions.title: Hoods Up

skins.name: Bandit Shade
skins.story: Nobody has ever seen what is under the red bandana, only the cold blue eyes above it when he takes your bed.

skins.name: Copper Fox
skins.story: He stitched fox ears and a bushy tail onto his hoodie for a joke, and now the whole server is scared of the orange blur in the trees.

skins.name: Split Signal
skins.story: Half teal, half night: she switches sides of the arena mid-fight and nobody can tell which team she is on.

versions.note: Three new fighters pull their hoods up and keep their secrets: a masked raider, a fox with ears on his hood and a hoodie cut clean down the middle.

versions.title: Suited for Battle

skins.name: Iron Zip
skins.story: He wears his iron chestplate under an open zip hoodie, pushes the hood back before every duel and still has the scar from the first one he lost.

skins.name: Hazard Runner
skins.story: Strapped into a hazard-orange harness with goggles over his eyes, he is the courier who always gets through the warzone.

skins.name: Frost Wrap
skins.story: She fights in the snow biome with a fur-trimmed hood and a scarf so long it trails behind her like a red flag.

versions.note: The arena got rougher, so three fighters gear up: iron under the zip, a hazard harness over the hood and a thick knit scarf against the cold.

versions.title: Loud Prints

skins.name: Tie-Dye Tempest
skins.story: She dyed her hoodie in a bucket of every colour she could craft and fights with a grin as loud as her clothes.

skins.name: Twin Blade
skins.story: Two crossed swords on his chest and one down his back: he wears the duel he has never lost.

skins.name: Ember Fade
skins.story: His hoodie burns from coal at the shoulders to flame at the hem, and in the shadow of his hood only two embers glow.

versions.note: Plain hoodies are out: a tie-dye storm, a giant crossed-swords print and a hoodie that fades from coal to flame.
